note: Simple Styleguide renders one page at /simple-styleguide (route simple_styleguide.controller, permission 'access style guide') showing selected built-in patterns, a colour palette, and custom patterns. Settings live in config object simple_styleguide.styleguidesettings (keys default_patterns = a checkboxes map over the 11 built-ins headings/text/lists/blockquote/rule/table/alerts/breadcrumbs/forms/buttons/pagination, and default_colors = array of '#hex|class|desc' strings). Custom patterns are styleguide_pattern config entities (config names simple_styleguide.styleguide_pattern.<id>; fields id,label,pattern(raw html),description,weight; admin_permission 'administer style guide') managed at /admin/config/styleguide/patterns. Two permissions: 'access style guide', 'administer style guide' (restrict access). Theme hooks simple_styleguide + simple_styleguide_pattern (per-id suggestion simple_styleguide_pattern__<id>); library simple_styleguide.default; page forced noindex,nofollow. No Drush, no plugin types. Medium cases read the live config entity + settings; hard cases create a custom pattern entity and toggle built-in patterns, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: In the simple_styleguide module, at what path is the styleguide page shown, what permission controls access to it, and what kind of entity stores a custom pattern I add?
evals.expected_output: The styleguide renders at /simple-styleguide (route simple_styleguide.controller), gated by the 'access style guide' permission. Custom patterns are 'styleguide_pattern' config entities (config names simple_styleguide.styleguide_pattern.<id>).

evals.prompt: Which built-in default patterns can I toggle on the simple_styleguide settings form, and in which config object is that selection stored?
evals.expected_output: The 11 built-ins are headings, text, lists, blockquote, rule, table, alerts, breadcrumbs, forms, buttons, pagination. The selection is stored under key default_patterns in the config object simple_styleguide.styleguidesettings (colours are in default_colors as '#hex|class|desc' strings).

evals.prompt: What permissions does the simple_styleguide module define and what does each control?
evals.expected_output: 'access style guide' controls viewing the /simple-styleguide page; 'administer style guide' (restrict access) is the admin permission for managing custom styleguide_pattern entities. The settings form itself is gated by core 'administer site configuration'.

evals.prompt: This site has a custom Simple Styleguide pattern configured. Inspect the site's styleguide_pattern config entities and tell me the machine name (id) of the custom pattern.
evals.expected_output: The custom pattern's id is ssg_known (config simple_styleguide.styleguide_pattern.ssg_known, label 'SSG Known Card'). Find it via the styleguide_pattern entity storage or drush config:get.

evals.prompt: On this site, which built-in Simple Styleguide default patterns are currently enabled to appear on the styleguide page? Inspect the live configuration and name them.
evals.expected_output: headings and buttons are enabled; all other built-ins are disabled (0). Read simple_styleguide.styleguidesettings.default_patterns, e.g. drush cget simple_styleguide.styleguidesettings default_patterns.

evals.prompt:
On this site, use the simple_styleguide module to add a custom styleguide pattern with machine name 'ssg_task', label 'SSG Task Card', and raw HTML pattern '
Task
'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output:
Create a styleguide_pattern config entity id=ssg_task, label='SSG Task Card', pattern='
Task
' (StyleguidePattern::create([...])->save() or the Add styleguide pattern form at /admin/config/styleguide/patterns/add). Stored as simple_styleguide.styleguide_pattern.ssg_task.

evals.prompt: On this site, configure the simple_styleguide module so that the built-in 'blockquote' and 'table' default patterns are shown on the styleguide page. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In simple_styleguide.styleguidesettings set default_patterns.blockquote and default_patterns.table to a truthy value (their own key), e.g. via the settings form at /admin/config/styleguide/settings or config edit.
